environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: a custom rule matching requests where the query string contains any character from the set [;'"\-] URL-decoded, returning a fixed 403 response (configured via ALB fixed-response action with condition 'query-string' using key-value pattern matching with values containing the encoded variants %27 %22 %3B %2D%2D). (2) Priority 10: AWS WAF WebACL attached to the ALB with rule group 'CommonRuleSet' from AWS Managed Rules in COUNT mode only (not block). (3) Priority 20: default forward to target group. Additionally, the ECS task definition sets the container as read-only filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with a tmpfs mount at /tmp only.
